serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I can’t beat her at chess and cards, but!
I know a game I can beat her in!
You: {f_botName}?
Bot: Yes?
You: Let’s play a game!
Bot: What kind of a game?
You: Word chain. Do you know how it works?
Bot: I don’t think so.
You: First we pick a category, then the first player says a random word from that category. The second player has to say a word starting with the last letter of the previous word and so on.
You: And the words have to be unique. 
Bot: Oh, that’s simple.
You: Yup. I used to play it a lot as a kid. Like when I was really small.
Bot: Let’s play it then!
You: Okay.
Now my secret weapon!
You: The category is Anime!
Bot: Anime?
You: Yes. I happen to be an expert on this subject! Let’s go then!
You: Axe Art Online!
Hahahaha there is no way she knows any anime! I’m going to win easily!
Bot: E…
Hahahaha struggle little one. No way you can defeat me in my homeland!
Bot: Elfen Song!
You: …
You: WHAT!?!
Bot: Is that your answer?
You: No, no.
Fuck, it looks like she has some data about anime. Not good.
I won’t let her defeat me though!
